name: Ahithophel
summary: David's counselor from Giloh, whose advice was trusted as if it came from God. He joined Absalom's revolt, and when his advice was not followed he went home and hanged himself.

key_moments.title: Joining the Conspiracy
key_moments.description: Absalom sent for Ahithophel from his city of Giloh, and the plot grew strong. When David heard that Ahithophel had joined Absalom, he prayed that the LORD would turn his counsel into foolishness.

key_moments.title: Advice Overturned
key_moments.description: Ahithophel urged Absalom to let him take twelve thousand men and strike David that night. But Absalom chose Hushai's plan instead, for the LORD had appointed that Ahithophel's good counsel would be defeated.

key_moments.title: Hangs Himself at Home
key_moments.description: When Ahithophel saw that Absalom had passed over his advice, he rode home to his city on his donkey. He set his house in order, hanged himself, and was buried in his father's tomb.
